name: Rust & Reveal: Restoration Simulator
storyline:
Your old pickup gives out at the edge of a small American town, and the part you need is a week away. With nothing to do but wait, you start noticing something strange: every morning, the townsfolk drag perfectly good things out to the curb. Rusty tools, dusty radios, forgotten lamps, and now and then something genuinely precious.

On the edge of town, an old junk shop has been sitting empty for years. You have almost no money, but the local shopkeepers decide to take a chance on you. The hardware store lends you tools, the landlord lets the first month slide, and the grocer puts it all on your tab. You open the doors again.

One restored treasure at a time, you pay the town back, earn your place among its people, and work toward the day the old junk shop is finally yours.
summary: Rust & Reveal: Restoration Simulator is a first-person simulation game in which players search through discarded objects to discover valuable items. Found objects can be cleaned and restored using different tools or dismantled into raw materials. Players manage their inventory, display restored items for sale, negotiate with customers, and earn money to repay their debts and expand their restoration business.
